about: An open-source app for building and testing APIs, with REST, GraphQL, WebSockets and gRPC.

prs.title: "No Auth" requests from Postman stay without a login
prs.broken: A Postman request set to No Auth was imported as "inherit", so it quietly sent the folder's or collection's token or API key.
prs.changed: I made the importer turn Postman's No Auth into Insomnia's own No Auth setting, so it stops inheritance as Postman does.
prs.matters: Moving a collection from Postman no longer sends secrets to endpoints that should get none.
